A room with a view
Moyo Tented Camp delivers the most authentic African experience and immerses you in the heart and soul of Africa. Our luxury tented properties are thoughtfully located in prime wildlife areas in the Serengeti to deliver exceptional year-round game viewing.
A stay with Moyo is more than an accommodation, it’s an experience. Our guests are welcomed with warm African hospitality, enjoy chef prepared meals, surrounded by the sights and sounds of Africa. It’s a magical place where the tranquility of nature and concierge service intersect.
View fullsize
Why Stay With Us?
Prime Location
Concierge Service
Positive Impact
Warm Hospitality
Learn more
Camps Location
Surrounded by untouched wilderness, our properties offer a rare blend of authentic connection with nature, modern accommodations, and personalized service.
Our camps take the phrase, “a room with a view” to a whole new level.
Our camps feature spacious guest tents that provide all the modern comforts of home , including ensuite bathrooms with flushing toilets, and 24-hour hot showers.
Our luxurious tents feature private verandas set on raised wooden platforms, complete with classic safari chairs.
This is an ideal spot to enjoy your morning coffee and soak in the tranquility of the early light .
“Don’t be surprised if you spot the “locals”, a family of giraffes
or elephants, wandering by the camps.”
Check out our camps
Central Serengeti Moyo Camp Warangi
Our luxury tented camp is nestled in the Serengeti National Reserve in the Seronera Valley, known as the big cat capital of Africa and one the most popular areas in the entire reserve
Discover this camp
Central Serengeti Moyo Camp Hembe
Our Hembe Camp is an intimate boutique property with 12 spacious tents, each designed for comfort and privacy, where guests can enjoy both spectacular sunrises and breathtaking sunsets
Discover this camp
Northern Serengeti Moyo Migration Camp Mara
Moyo Migration Camp is a permanent camp location in the heart of the Northern Serengeti, allowing guests to enjoy the magic of the Serengeti in every season
Discover this camp
Experiences
Game Drive
Experience the wild with front-row seats to nature's greatest show. From dawn lion encounters to the drama of the Great Migration, every drive delivers unforgettable moments in our custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides who bring the Serengeti to life. More
Discover this camp
Hot Air Balloon Ride
Drift silently above the endless Serengeti at sunrise, witnessing the epic scale of wildlife migration and predator drama from a bird's eye view. Experience the breathtaking beauty of the savannah from above, followed by a celebratory bush breakfast in the heart of the wilderness. More
Discover this camp
Sundowner
Embrace the timeless safari tradition as your expert guide selects the perfect scenic location to watch the sun paint the sky in vibrant colors. Relax with your favorite beverage and reflect on the day's wildlife adventures in the peaceful splendor of the Serengeti. More
Discover this camp
Spa
Unwind in our Serengeti spa with open-air rituals, soothing massages, and African-inspired treatments.
Overlook vast plains, hear nature’s soundtrack, and restore body and spirit in a place where wilderness meets tranquility. More
Click Here
Walking Safari
Experience the bush on foot, guided by experts and armed rangers.
Track wildlife, read fresh prints and feel nature up close.
Walking safaris run only in Seronera at Hembe and Warangi camps. More
Click Here
Maasai Tribal Visit
Immerse yourself in authentic Maasai culture through respectful village visits with traditional singing, dancing and spear throwing demonstrations. Learn about ancient customs and discover how this warrior community has harmoniously coexisted with the Serengeti's wildlife for centuries through meaningful cultural exchange. More
Click Here
Wine To Water
Witness the transformative power of clean water at this inspiring nonprofit near Arusha, where locally crafted ceramic filters are handmade using clay and silver. Meet the dedicated team, see the filter making process, and have the opportunity to hand deliver life changing water solutions directly to families in need. More
Click Here
Albino Camp
Visit a local refuge camp dedicated to supporting Tanzania's albinism community, where you'll hear powerful personal stories of resilience and hope. Learn about the vital advocacy work protecting and empowering individuals facing unique social and health challenges while gaining insight into this important humanitarian mission. More
Click Here
Kilimanjaro Climb
Conquer Africa's highest peak at 19,341 feet with a 6 to 8 day trek through stunning ecosystems from rainforest to snow capped summit. No technical gear required, just determination and acclimatization, or explore the breathtaking lower slopes for an equally rewarding mountain adventure. More

Our Story
MOYO
{ˈmoʊ.joʊ} noun
“ Moyo ” means heart in Swahili
“ Moyo ” means heart in Swahili. At the heart of all we do is a deep love for Tanzania, its people, wildlife, and untamed beauty.
Our mission begins with creating a truly unforgettable African journey for you at Moyo Tented Camp , while embracing the spirit of Travel With Purpose . We strive not only to delight our guests but also to leave a lasting, positive impact on the community.
“Travel With Purpose”
Our dedicated team delivers exceptional , personalized service, driven by the belief that tourism can change lives when guided by heart and commitment. We proudly provide employment, especially empowering women in key leadership roles, and support conservation efforts, local farmers, artists, and woodworkers.
Our vision reaches beyond the camp.
We believe that water and education changes everything.
We support projects that include building schools, bringing clean water to villages, and empowering future generations.

Availability
& FAQ
To help you plan your trip with Moyo, see the current availability at our three properties
How do I get from my arrival airport to your camps?
Upon your arrival at either Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport, a representative from Moyo Tented Camp will welcome you and assist with check-in for your connecting flight to the Serengeti.
Depending on your reservation, you will fly to either Central or Northern Serengeti, where Moyo Tented Camp is located. On arrival at the designated airstrip, our camp guide and vehicle will be waiting to receive you and transfer you directly to camp, where your safari experience begins.
What should I pack for my safari?
As a general rule, pack comfortable, lightweight neutral colored clothing that you can layer. The morning will be cooler with the temperature increasing swiftly as the sun rises. Game drives are in the early morning and mid-afternoon so wearing clothes that you can layer is key. Same day laundry service for small loads is available for a nominal fee. Packing light is typically the best advice.
If you are flying between your chosen safari camps and lodges in light aircraft the luggage allowance limits you to a maximum of 15 kg (33 lbs), which includes your carry-on hand luggage.
Do you have Wifi?
Yes, wifi is available at all our properties in our common dining/lounging tent. Our connection is adequate for connecting on social media and checking email, however it is generally not suitable for live streaming or heavy usage applications.
When is the best time to visit Serengeti?
The Serengeti is a spectacular year-round safari destination, but the best time really depends on what you want to see and experience.
For the Great Migration and river crossings , visit July–October. For calving season with dramatic predator action, January–March is ideal. April–May and November–December offer lush landscapes, fewer crowds, and excellent photography.
What about dietary restrictions?
Please let us know about any food allergies when booking. Our chefs prepare a delicious, varied menu aimed to delight. We make every effort to source locally grown ingredients to prepare the freshest farm to table meals. We are happy to accommodate special diets and food restrictions such as food allergies/intolerance, vegetarian, vegan. Please give us advance notice of food restrictions and any special requests so we are sure to meet and exceed expectations.
Cancellation Policy
At Moyo Tented Camp, we understand that travel plans may change. To best accommodate our guests while ensuring smooth camp operations, we have the following cancellation policy in place:
Cancellation between 90 and 61 days : 20% of the full reservation amount will be charged.
Cancellation between 60 and 31 days : 50% of the full reservation amount will be charged.
Cancellation within 30 days or less prior to arrival, or no-show : 100% of the full reservation amount will be charged.
Our recommended packing list :
Clothes in neutral colors like khaki, green and tan work well as they are cooler in the heat of the day. They blend with the environment to allow you to get closer to wildlife without disturbing them.
Jeans or safari trousers for evenings and cooler days.
Shorts or a light skirt.
A lightweight waterproof jacket and fleece for those early mornings and evenings.
Long-sleeved shirts offer protection from the sun especially if they are SPF rated.
Cotton T-shirts are the ideal base layer.
Swimsuit if staying at a camp with a pool.
Comfortable walking shoes and a pair of flip flops, thongs or slops.
Sun hat with a brim.
Binoculars and camera with extra batteries.
Hair dryer if needed as those are not in the rooms.
Sunscreen, sunglasses, insect repellent, moisturizer and lip salve.
Calendar
Here is a Safari Calendar to give you a more detailed look at the Serengeti season
January – March | Calving Season
(Ndutu Plains, Southern Serengeti)
• Over 400,000 wildebeest calves are born in just a few weeks
• Predator sightings are intense (lions, cheetahs, hyenas)
• Lush green landscapes, great for photography
• Excellent family safari season with shorter game drives
Book Now
April – May | Long Rains
(Central & Western Serengeti) Moyo Warangi & Hembe Camps
• Green, dramatic scenery, fewer visitors = more intimate safaris
• Afternoon showers possible, but wildlife is still abundant
• Best value season : many camps offer reduced rates
Book Now
